text.tspan: 11 products run out within 60 days at the pace of the last six months.
Nine are already oversold, so they are the priority; the reorder quantity covers the backlog
Two are still in stock but will not last: SW10011 Aerodynamic Linen Screen Seder sells 0.11 a day
and runs out on 28 October (order 5), SW10095 Hank’s Gadget on 6 November (order 2).
Products without sales in the window are not listed; nothing here is a guess.
